title: The Science Behind Sunset Colors
description: An explanation of why the sky turns red at sunset, condensed for a 60-second runtime.
instagram_caption: Ever wonder why the sky catches fire at sunset? It’s all about light, atmosphere, and a little bit of physics. 🌅✨ #ScienceFacts #SunsetColors #NatureExplained #WondersOfTheNature

segments.narration: Every evening, the sky pulls off a disappearing act, trading a steady blue for a burning, deep crimson as the sun slips away.
Sunlight is actually a hidden rainbow. As light enters our atmosphere, gas molecules scatter the short blue waves in every direction, filtering them out while leaving the longer waves behind.
But when the sun dips low, the light travels a longer path through the atmosphere, forcing only the deep reds, oranges, and fiery tones—amplified by dust and smoke—to finally reach your eyes.
Tonight, take a quiet moment to watch the transformation for yourself, and follow Wonders of the Nature for more.
